description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002435
DOCKET NO. F00649926
PLAINTIFF – WILMINGTON SAVING FUND SOCIETY, FSB, NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY BUT SOLELY AS TRUSTEE ON BEHALF OF HOMES 2024-NQM2 TRUST
DEFENDANTS- JZFRIED LINDEN LLC, A NEW YORK LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY, JOEL FRIEDMAN A/K/A JOEL FREIDMAN, INDIVIDUALLY AND AS MEMBER OF JZFRIED LINDEN LLC, A NEW YORK LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 2nd DAY OF December 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of LINDEN, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 20 BLOCK 309
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
906 DEWITT STREET LINDEN, NJ 07036
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: 40' x 120' NEAREST CROSS STREET: Gesner Street
A full legal description can be found at the Office of the Register
Taxes and Other Encumbrances:
Taxes current through 3rd Quarter of 2026
Water Plaintiff is unable to confirm these amounts. Prospective purchasers must conduct their own investigation to determine the same.
Sewer current through September 30, 2026*
*Plus interest on these figures through date of payoff and any and all subsequent taxes, water and sewer amounts.
Upset Price: $493 ,320.51 good through March 11, 2027 and any additional sums as ordered by the court.
Occupancy Status: Occupancy status at the property is unknown.
SUBJECT TO THE CONDITIONS OF SALE AS SET FORTH BY THE SHERIFF WHO
RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THE SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION
SURPLUS IF AFTER THE SALE AND SATISFACTION OF THE MORTGAGE DEBT, INCLUDING COSTS AND EXPENSES, THERE REMAINS ANY SURPLUS MONEY, THE MONEY WILL BE DEPOSITED INTO THE SUPERIOR COURT TRUST FUND AND ANY PERSON
CLAIMING THE SURPLUS, OR ANY PART THEREOF, MAY FILE A MOTION PURSUANT TO COURT RULES 4:64-3 AND STATING THE NATURE AND EXTENT OF THAT PERSON'S CLAIM AND ASKING FOR AN ORDER DIRECTING PAYMENT OF THE SURPLUS MONEY. THE SHERIFF OR OTHER PERSON CONDUCTING THE SALE WILL HAVE INFORMATION REGARDING THE SURPLUS, IF ANY.
SUBJECT TO: SUCH FACTS AS AN ACCURATE SURVEY AND PHYSICAL INSPECTION OF THE PREMISES MAY REVEAL, EASEMENTS
AND RESTRICTIONS OF RECORD, IF ANY; UNPAID TAXES, ASSESSMENTS, WATER AND SEWER LIENS, IF ANY; RIGHTS OF TENANTS
AND OCCUPANTS, IF ANY; STATE AND MUNICIPAL ORDINANCES, STATUTES AND REGULATIONS, INCLUDING ZONING ORDINANCES;
ANY OUTSTANDING TAXES, WATER AND SEWER WITH INTEREST THROUGH THE DATE OF PAYOFF; IF THE SALE IS SET ASIDE FOR
ANY REASON, THE PURCHASER AT THE SALE SHALL BE ENTITLED ONLY TOA RETURN OF THE DEPOSIT PAID. THE PURCHASER
SHALL HAVE NO FURTHER RECOURSE, INCLUDING ANY COST AND EXPENSES, INCL
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $453,328.21 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
Advertised on our website: https://ucnj.org/sheriff/functions/sheriffs-sale-information/
DATED: October 26, 2026
STERN & EISENBERG, PC
1120 ROUTE 73
SUITE 400
MOUNT LAUREL, NJ 08054
(609)397-9200
